fact: Africa Legal reports Ethiopia's Parliament unanimously approved the Startup Proclamation, which still needed gazetting in the Federal Negarit Gazette and Council of Ministers regulations.
Minister Tamru said eligible startups would benefit from incentives and support under the country's ratified Startup Proclamation.
GIZ states Ethiopia ratified its first Startup Proclamation in July 2025, recognising startups under a dedicated regulatory framework.
The Reporter Magazine says Parliament ratified the Startup Proclamation on 17 July 2025, creating a legal category for startups with five-year tax exemptions for designated startups.
The document says the call for applications to the timbuktoo ManuTech Hub was announced at a public consultation of Ethiopia's startup proclamation.
